limitations: Training ranges assume a future validated vLLM rollout integration; current production trainer remains serial HF.
Component samples use four initial-checkpoint MATH contexts at alpha=0. No complete live-policy training loop was measured.
Planning bands are judgmental allowances, not statistical confidence intervals.
Checkpoint I/O, weight synchronization and runtime recovery not measured in this test.
The fixed GPT-polluter baseline is not implemented; its estimate assumes 1000 agent updates and one GPT corruption per context.
API latency comes from one earlier response, with no extra paid calls made for this test.
Human corpus review and implementation time are not estimated.
